get.summary: Get Form Data Array For Form
get.description: Retrieves form data for all instances of a form in Alpha TransForm.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: FormId of the form definition

schema.description: FormId of the form definition

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of forms per page. Maximum allowed page size is 200.

schema.description: The number of forms per page. Maximum allowed page size is 200.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for which data is returned

schema.description: The page number for which data is returned

parameters.name: resolveMediaFields
parameters.description: determine if coded data for media fields is resolved to the actual URL on Amazon S3.

schema.description: determine if coded data for media fields is resolved to the actual URL on Amazon S3.

parameters.name: getRecordCount
parameters.description: if true, count of number of records is returned

schema.description: if true, count of number of records is returned

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: timestamp when record was last updated. Format is yyyy-mm-dd 0h:0m:0s

schema.description: timestamp when record was last updated. Format is yyyy-mm-dd 0h:0m:0s

parameters.name: fieldList
parameters.description: a list of the top level form fields that you want to return data from. if blank then data for all form fields are returned.

schema.description: a list of the top level form fields that you want to return data from. if blank then data for all form fields are returned.

parameters.name: injectFormMetaDataIntoData
parameters.description: specifies if form meta data (i.e. name of user filling in form, form status, etc.) should be injected into the formdata return by the method.

schema.description: specifies if form meta data (i.e. name of user filling in form, form status, etc.) should be injected into the formdata return by the method.

parameters.name: otheroptions
parameters.description: other options (in a JSON format)

schema.description: other options (in a JSON format)

parameters.name: returnMediaFileList
parameters.description: specify if an array of media files should be returned - only honored if 'resolveMediaFields' is not true.

schema.description: specify if an array of media files should be returned - only honored if 'resolveMediaFields' is not true.

parameters.name: getFormDefinition
parameters.description: specify if the form definition should also be returned

schema.description: specify if the form definition should also be returned

parameters.name: formDataFilterJavascript
parameters.description: Javascript code to filter the form data. Your Javascript code must return true or false. If true the formdata is included in the return result. Your Javascript code can reference form fields using this syntax: data.formdata.name_of_field (e.g. if(data.formdata.color == 'red') return true; ). If you specify a formdata filter you should also specify a metadata filter to limit that number of rows that need to be searched.

schema.description: Javascript code to filter the form data. Your Javascript code must return true or false. If true the formdata is included in the return result. Your Javascript code can reference form fields using this syntax: data.formdata.name_of_field (e.g. if(data.formdata.color == 'red') return true; ). If you specify a formdata filter you should also specify a metadata filter to limit that number of rows that need to be searched.

parameters.name: metadatafilter
parameters.description: Filter based on meta data fields. Syntax is SQL. E.g.: person = '[email protected]' and status = 'open'

schema.description: Filter based on meta data fields. Syntax is SQL. E.g.: person = '[email protected]' and status = 'open'

parameters.name: metadatafilterparameters
parameters.description: If the metadata filter uses arguments, supplies the argument values. Format is a crlf delimited string of format value|||type|parametername

schema.description: If the metadata filter uses arguments, supplies the argument values. Format is a crlf delimited string of format value|||type|parametername

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
